_comment: Shared merge contract for the GameStatistics model JSON.
This file must stay in sync with the copy in the backend repository at
tests/SnakeClassic.Application.Tests/Fixtures/statistics_merge_contract.json.
TWO checks enforce that, and it is worth knowing what each one can and
cannot see:
1. Same-repo check (always runs). Each repo asserts its own field lists
against its own copy of this file. Catches 'I edited the merge list
and forgot the fixture'. It CANNOT catch a change made correctly in
one repo and never mirrored to the other — updating a list and this
file together leaves that repo green while the other stays stale.
2. Cross-repo check (runs only when both repos are checked out as
siblings, e.g. a local dev machine). Compares this file against the
other repo's copy and fails on any difference. This is the check that
actually detects drift. It SKIPS when the sibling repo is absent, so
it protects a developer with both repos, not an isolated CI job.
If the two repos ever build in CI without each other, neither check will
catch drift and you need a shared source or a job that fetches both.
Bump 'version' whenever the field lists change — the cross-repo check
compares it, so a stale copy fails on the version alone even if someone
reorders the arrays.
Dart:  lib/services/sync/statistics_merge.dart
C#:    Features/Sync/Commands/SyncStatistics/SyncStatisticsCommandHandler.cs
